title: MoveWall Command
description: Move one straight wall run across itself, then rebuild that host wall from its path. A baked plan is one wall record (forsk:path: the outer outline and the rooms it closes), so the run is picked inside it: side for an outer wall, or the face nearest at. Wall records that touch are read as one shape, so the run may span records. Both faces move; the walls joined to the run stretch or shorten along their own lines, in every record that touches, and the openings on the run move with it. The result names the walls that followed. The floor slab and flat roof from that record are rebuilt, and rooms are detected again. A shown daylight map is hidden as out of date. A move that would close a room or cross a wall is refused with the depth it ran into, and a refused rebuild leaves the document unchanged. Id omitted uses the one selected wall, else the wall nearest at, else the only wall. Refuses X-EXIST.

id.description: Wall GUID. Omit to use the selected wall, or the only one.

side.description: The outer wall facing this way. Exclusive with at.

at.description: [x, y] in mm on or beside the wall: the face nearest it, within 1000 mm. Exclusive with side.

toward.description: The way the wall moves: across the run (an east–west wall moves north or south).
